fly.name: Fly
fly.passive: Random straight lines before stopping and changing directions. Very fast.
fly.aggro_trigger: Uranium, bulb or nearby friendly unit
fly.aggro_behavior: Toward the friendly unit in a curvy motion. Very fast
fly.special: Has a 50% chance of dodging attacks.

soldier_ant.name: Soldier Ant
soldier_ant.passive: Random straight lines for a few tiles before stopping and changing directions. Slow
soldier_ant.aggro_trigger: Uranium, bulb or nearby friendly unit
soldier_ant.aggro_behavior: Towards the friendly unit with a slight delay in changing directions. Moderate speed
soldier_ant.special: If associated with an Ant Hole, stops being aggressive if far from the Ant Hole. Some automatically spawn with Ant Holes and when the Ant Hole is damaged.

wasp.name: Wasp
wasp.passive: Random curved lines for a few tiles before stopping and changing directions. Slow
wasp.aggro_trigger: Uranium, bulb or nearby friendly unit
wasp.aggro_behavior: Toward the friendly unit. Moderate speed. Stops ~5 tiles away from the friendly unit and slowly circles. Rapidly shoots missiles toward the friendly unit if they're nearby, stopping and turning around when doing so. Missiles inflict slight recoil on the mob.
wasp.ultra_behavior:
Periodically fires missiles in a circle (missiles are of two rarities beneath the boss's). Recoil still occurs during this attack, so the wasp moves in a large circle.

Periodically spawns 5 wasps two rarities beneath the boss's.
wasp.special:
Fires missiles at the player.
Epic+ spawn as "Einstein" wasps that shoot based on the predicted location of the player. Higher rarity wasps shoot missiles more often.

worker_ant.name: Worker Ant
worker_ant.passive: Random straight lines for a few tiles before stopping and changing directions. Slow
worker_ant.aggro_behavior: Towards the friendly unit with a slight delay in changing directions. Moderate speed
worker_ant.special: If it's associated with an Ant Hole, it becomes aggressive toward the player if the Ant Hole is damaged. Stops being aggressive if far from the Ant Hole. Some automatically spawn with Ant Holes and when the Ant Hole is damaged.

beetle_hel.name: Beetle (Hel)
beetle_hel.passive: Random straight lines for a few tiles before stopping and changing directions. Slow
beetle_hel.aggro_trigger: Uranium, bulb or nearby friendly unit
beetle_hel.aggro_behavior: Towards the friendly unit. Turns slowly. Fast.

ant_egg.name: Ant Egg
ant_egg.special:
Spawns naturally only in specific areas and may release an aggressive Baby Ant on death.
Can also be laid by Queen Ants, spawning two rarities below the queen ant's rarity. Eggs laid by Queens shortly hatch into a Soldier Ant of the same rarity.

crab.name: Crab
crab.passive: Random curved lines for a few tiles before stopping and changing directions. Slow
crab.aggro_trigger: Uranium, bulb or nearby friendly unit
crab.aggro_behavior: Toward the friendly unit but attempts to stay a distance away by running in circles around the friendly unit. Charges at the friendly unit randomly, not changing directions while doing so. If it misses, it'll circle again. Very fast

soldier_termite.aggro_trigger: Uranium, bulb, nearby friendly unit or damage to a nearby Termite Egg
soldier_termite.aggro_behavior: Towards the friendly unit. Moderate speed
soldier_termite.special: Splits damage with all other nearby termites.

cactus.name: Cactus
cactus.special: Spawns with varying sizes/HP, even among the same rarity. May be pushed around slowly by other mobs and certain petals. Its spikes have separate HP and damages and are destroyed when the mob dies or they run out of HP (they do not shoot).

eof.name: EOF
eof.special: Has infinite HP (despite what the stat says). Changes colors with status effects like flowers do.

ant_hole.name: Ant Hole
ant_hole.special:
Low spawn rate. Spawns ants when damaged. 
If it's rare or higher, the hole can't be damaged, instead being entered upon touch. All ants are the same rarity as the hole or 1 or 2 rarities below.
Each hole counts as a separate area. Living squad mates not in the same area as the player show up with a question mark (dead ones show up as dead). Players in the hole may only leave after all ants in the hole have been killed. Moving to a new area grants 1 second of invincibility.
Rare+ Ant Holes will die after awhile if ants have been spawned, releasing everything inside (except petals with a laydown ability).

sandstorm.special: Spawns with varying sizes/HP, even among the same rarity.

digger.name: Digger
digger.passive: Wanders in straight lines, turning randomly when hitting a wall. Moderate speed.
digger.defensive_behavior: Away from hostile mobs. Moderate speed.
digger.special:
Friendly unit - Does not harm player, damages hostile mobs.

Small chance (10%) of spawning in a rare+ Ant Hole/Fire Ant Burrow when the first player enters it, matching the mobs's rarity. Automatically loses HP over time.

rock.name: Rock
rock.ultra_behavior: Shoots out rocks 2-3 rarities beneath it at regular damage intervals. Rocks travel a short distance before stopping.
rock.special: Spawns with varying sizes/HP, even among the same rarity. May be pushed around slowly by other mobs and certain petals.

dandelion.special: Shoots out 10 dandelions upon first damage, shooting out one a time until the full circle is released. Each dandelion projectile may be destroyed by contact before it is shot. Dandelions reduce healing by 20%, stacking multiplicatively, for 30 seconds.

leech.aggro_behavior: Toward the friendly unit. Once it makes contact with the target, it'll move at the same speed, periodically draining HP from the victim to heal itself. It is immune to body damage while doing this. Very fast
leech.special: Has multiple segments that share health, so lightning can chain between them.

termite_mound.name: Termite Mound
termite_mound.special:
Low spawn rate. Spawns termites when damaged. 
If it's rare or higher, the hole can't be damaged, instead being entered upon touch. All termites are rare except for the queen who matches the hole's rarity. 
Each hole counts as a separate area. Living squad mates not in the same area as the player show up with a question mark (dead ones show up as dead). Players in the hole may only leave after all termites in the hole have been killed. Moving to a new area grants 1 second of invincibility.
Rare+ Termite Holes will die after awhile if termites have been spawned, releasing everything inside (except petals with a laydown ability).

jellyfish.ultra_behavior: Occasionally releases shockwaves that damage all nearby flowers, destroys all nearby petals and temporarily disables most petals. Disabled petals have an X over them and do not orbit. Not orbiting petals still retain passive effects if disabled.
jellyfish.special: Shoots lightning in a moderate radius around it.

When below 50% health, enters defensive mode unless under the influence of a lot of dandelions. Can become aggressive again once at full health.
